%md
# profile_source

Profiles Bronze (an as-is copy of the source) to build the allowed-value lists and to record
the date ranges and the lines-per-order distribution. Read-only: it writes no tables.

Requires `01_bronze_ingest` to have run for the same `catalog` and `schema_prefix`.

%md
## Value profiling

### Categorical values
Every distinct value with its row count. NULL appears as its own row. `value_length` and the
bracketed value make leading or trailing whitespace visible.

lineitem_values = spark.sql(f"""
    SELECT column_name, concat('[', value, ']') AS bracketed_value, length(value) AS value_length,
           count(*) AS row_count
    FROM (
        SELECT stack(3,
                     'l_shipmode', l_shipmode,
                     'l_returnflag', l_returnflag,

order_priority_values = spark.sql(f"""
    SELECT 'o_orderpriority' AS column_name, concat('[', o_orderpriority, ']') AS bracketed_value,
           length(o_orderpriority) AS value_length, count(*) AS row_count
    FROM {bronze_schema}.orders
    GROUP BY o_orderpriority
    ORDER BY o_orderpriorit

date_ranges = spark.sql(f"""
    SELECT 'l_shipdate' AS column_name, min(l_shipdate) AS min_date, max(l_shipdate) AS max_date,
           count_if(l_shipdate IS NULL) AS null_count
    FROM {bronze_schema}.lineitem
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'l_commitdate', min(l_commitdate), max(l_commitdate), count_

%md
### Lines per order
Starts from every order, so an order without line items counts as 0 lines instead of being
left out.

lines_per_order = spark.sql(f"""

        FROM {bronze_schema}.lineitem
        GROUP BY l_orderkey
    ),
    order_lines AS (
        SELECT o.o_orderkey, coalesce(lc.line_count, 0) AS line_count
        FROM {bronze_schema

%md
## Functional dependencies

3NF evidence (design §5.3): candidate keys, then each candidate non-key dependency `X → A`.
A dependency holds in this snapshot when no value of `X` has more than one distinct `A`.

%md
### Candidate keys
Declared primary keys must be unique and non-null. Name columns are checked as possible
alternative keys; an alternative key does not break 3NF, it only makes more attributes prime.
